Created by an experienced ham and adult educator, it's like having your own, patient, experienced, good-humored mentor for the exam. Technician is the entry-level ham radio license that lets you operate on all ham channels from 30 MHz up, which includes the very popular VHF and UHF bands. To get your license, you must pass a multiple-choice test. The Technician license test consists of 35 questions drawn from a pool of about 400. Memorizing the answers to 400 questions is difficult, but The Fast Track makes getting your license easy by explaining the logic behind each correct answer and by arranging the questions so they form a logical progression toward mastery of the material.
